def current_semantic_manifest(read, review, frozen):
    """Lossless current two-manifest view, retaining every original record."""
    rows = []
    for name, expected_count in [('original-copy-manifest.json',1276),('additional-original-copy-manifest.json',2)]:
        raw = read(review/name)
        assert raw == read(HERE/'current-inputs/semantic-review'/name)
        check_pin(raw,frozen[name])
        source = json.loads(raw); assert isinstance(source,list) and len(source) == expected_count
        for index, rec in enumerate(source):
            assert set(rec) == {'original_path','copy_path','content_addressed_copy','bytes','sha256'}
            assert Path(rec['original_path']).is_absolute()
            paths = [Path(rec[k]) for k in ('copy_path','content_addressed_copy')]
            assert all(p.is_absolute() and p.resolve(strict=True).is_relative_to(review.resolve()) for p in paths)
            rels = [str(p.relative_to(review)) for p in paths]
            for rel in rels:
                relative(rel); assert rel in frozen
                assert {k:rec[k] for k in ('bytes','sha256')} == {k:frozen[rel][k] for k in ('bytes','sha256')}
            rows.append(dict(original=rec['original_path'],copy=rels[0],content_addressed_copy=rels[1],bytes=rec['bytes'],sha256=rec['sha256'],source_manifest=name,source_index=index,original_record=rec))
    assert len(rows) == 1278
    return rows

    kind = entry['kind']

        return additional_root_predicate(raw,grouped,path,rec,data,values,build,physical)
    if kind == 'archived_closed282_continuation_line':
